attributes.long_name: relative vertical distribution of plant area volume: percent of the cell's mean GEDI PAVD profile in each height bin
attributes.definition: GEDI L2B V003 pavd_z: 'Vertical Plant Area Volume Density profile from ground (z=0) to canopy top with a vertical step size of dZ', m2 m-3 (GEDI L2B V3 product data dictionary).
attributes.statistic: mean pavd_z over kept footprints, then normalised to sum to 100 over height bins
attributes.comment: Plant-area volume only; the EBV specification also names biomass, which this variable does not carry.
